response.sql: WITH pairs AS (SELECT ab.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM pairs), avgs AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_record_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_type_avg FROM avgs WHERE share > avg_share GROUP BY tradekind
